items.headline: Mensah throws for 338 yards and 3 TDs, No. 6 Miami rolls past Central Michigan 52-3
items.description: — Darian Mensah was almost perfect, again. And No. 6 Miami got through September with a perfect record, again.

items.headline: No. 6 Miami, dealing with injuries, set to take on an excited Central Michigan team on Saturday
items.description: — Make no mistake, Central Michigan coach Matt Drinkall has every intention of pulling off what would be a gargantuan upset this weekend when his team visits No. 6 Miami.

items.headline: QB Angel Flores leads the way on the ground and Central Michigan tops Wyoming 24-10
items.description: — Quarterback Angel Flores ran for 163 yards with two scores, Central Michigan churned out 339 yards rushing and the Chippewas defeated Wyoming 24-10 on Saturday.

items.headline: Angel Flores, Vaughn Blue run for 2nd-half TDs to rally Central Michigan over Colgate 13-10
items.description: — Angel Flores and Vaughn Blue ran for second-half touchdowns and Central Michigan rallied to edge FCS opponent Colgate 13-10 on Saturday.
